description: Briefing synthesis — verify briefing is complete and ready for delivery

rules.name: briefing_delivered
rules.reason: Briefing must be delivered to controller (true). If false or missing, retry step.
rules.retry_instruction: The briefing_delivered field is empty. Populate it with a boolean (true/false) indicating whether the briefing was successfully synthesized and delivered to the controller.

rules.name: briefing_not_empty
rules.reason: Briefing must have content (at least some sections) — retry if empty
rules.retry_instruction: The briefing_sections field is empty. Re-execute step-05 to synthesize the briefing, populating this field with the main briefing sections (today's schedule, action items, follow-ups, and key decisions).

rules.name: briefing_covers_today
rules.reason: Briefing should include today's summary (warn if missing, don't retry)

rules.name: action_items_identified
rules.reason: Action items should be extracted (warn if none found, don't retry)
